instruction: A warehouse starts with 1305 boxes. It receives 2 deliveries of 54 boxes each. It receives 2 deliveries of 34 boxes each. It ships 14 boxes per day for 3 days. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory.
